tokens.name: cm-base
tokens.usage: Panel ground: the sidebar and the state sheet.

tokens.name: cm-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and rows that sit above `cm-base`.

tokens.name: cm-hover
tokens.usage: Wash under a hovered row, icon button or menu item.

tokens.name: cm-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and the new-note bar.

tokens.name: cm-input
tokens.usage: Fill of text fields.

tokens.name: cm-strip
tokens.usage: Tinted bands: the new-note strip and the delete confirmation.

tokens.name: cm-selected
tokens.usage: Wash on the selected row and on quoted words. Ink (`cm-text`) reads on it over `cm-raised`.

tokens.name: cm-accent-wash
tokens.usage: Active menu choice and an open trigger. Ink reads on it over `cm-raised`.

tokens.name: cm-halo
tokens.usage: 3px halo outside a focused field; also the quoted-text highlight on the host page.

tokens.name: cm-text
tokens.usage: Headings, names and primary text on `cm-base`, `cm-raised`, `cm-strip`.

tokens.name: cm-text-author
tokens.usage: Author names on `cm-raised` and `cm-base`.

tokens.name: cm-text-body
tokens.usage: Note and reply text on `cm-raised` and `cm-base`.

tokens.name: cm-text-meta
tokens.usage: Times, counts and secondary lines on `cm-raised` and `cm-base`.

tokens.name: cm-text-hint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and hints on `cm-input`, `cm-raised` and `cm-strip`.

tokens.name: cm-border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a surface.

tokens.name: cm-border
tokens.usage: Edges of fields, menus and banners.

tokens.name: cm-border-emph
tokens.usage: The edge of a control that must be seen to be used: checkboxes, radios, the new-note bar. Clears 3:1 on `cm-raised` and `cm-base`.

tokens.name: cm-control-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of anything you type in or press that is not yellow: fields, the Resolve button. Ink in light, so it matches the edge under a yellow button beside it; soft in dark, where a yellow button has no edge either.

tokens.name: cm-accent
tokens.usage: The highlighter. A fill behind ink only: pins, the active launcher, Send, checked boxes. On a light surface never text and never a thin line.

tokens.name: cm-accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as a foreground: links, the unread dot, checked marks. Ink in light, highlighter in dark.

tokens.name: cm-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of an accent button.

tokens.name: cm-on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text on `cm-accent` and `cm-accent-deep`.

tokens.name: cm-accent-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge under an accent fill, so yellow holds its shape on paper. Clear in dark.

tokens.name: cm-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and the border of a focused field, on every surface.

tokens.name: cm-card-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline round every floating card.

tokens.name: cm-ok
tokens.usage: Success text and marks on `cm-raised`.

tokens.name: cm-warn
tokens.usage: Warnings on `cm-raised`. Orange, so it is never read as the accent.

tokens.name: cm-err
tokens.usage: Error text on `cm-raised`; also an error fill under `cm-on-err`.

tokens.name: cm-on-err
tokens.usage: Text on an `cm-err` fill.

tokens.name: cm-info
tokens.usage: Informational marks on `cm-raised`.

tokens.name: cm-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral status marks on `cm-raised`.

tokens.name: cm-done
tokens.usage: Fill of the Resolved control.

tokens.name: cm-on-done
tokens.usage: The check on `cm-done`.

tokens.name: cm-send-off
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled Send.

tokens.name: cm-send-off-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph on `cm-send-off`. Deliberately faint: disabled.

tokens.name: cm-dock-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the launcher group in light. Clear in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-0
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 1 of 6 (teal): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-0-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-0`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-1
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 2 of 6 (pink): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-1-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-1`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-2
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 3 of 6 (blue): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-2-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-2`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-3
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 4 of 6 (green): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-3-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-3`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-4
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 5 of 6 (plum): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-4-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-4`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-5
tokens.usage: Face in a card or the panel, colour 6 of 6 (red): the pale wash in light, a dusk of the colour in dark.

tokens.name: cm-face-5-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-face-5`: the deep shade in light, the pale wash in dark.

tokens.name: cm-av-0
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 1 of 6 (teal): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-0-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-0`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-av-1
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 2 of 6 (pink): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-1-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-1`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-av-2
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 3 of 6 (blue): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-2-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-2`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-av-3
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 4 of 6 (green): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-3-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-3`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-av-4
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 5 of 6 (plum): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-4-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-4`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-av-5
tokens.usage: Face in a pin, colour 6 of 6 (red): a pale wash. Picked by a hash of the name shown. On the host page, so the same in both themes.

tokens.name: cm-av-5-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on `cm-av-5`: the deep shade of the same colour.

tokens.name: cm-pin-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed in both themes. Edge and glyph of pins, launcher fill, toast ground.

tokens.name: cm-pin-paper
tokens.usage: Fixed in both themes. Launcher glyph, toast text, the ground of a draft or resolved pin.

tokens.name: cm-pin-ring
tokens.usage: Fixed. Thin light ring outside a pin or launcher so it separates from a dark host page.

tokens.name: cm-pin-wash
tokens.usage: Fixed. The highlighter laid over the element a note is, or would be, pinned to. A fill only, never a line.

tokens.name: cm-s1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, lines inside a row.

tokens.name: cm-s2
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls; row padding.

tokens.name: cm-s3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between blocks in a card.

tokens.name: cm-s4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: cm-s5
tokens.usage: Space between groups in the panel.

tokens.name: cm-s6
tokens.usage: Outer margins of the state sheet.

tokens.name: cm-r-sm
tokens.usage: Fields and icon buttons.

tokens.name: cm-r-md
tokens.usage: Rows, menu items and buttons.

tokens.name: cm-r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and panels: three of the four corners.

tokens.name: cm-r-tip
tokens.usage: The one sharp corner of a pin or card. It points at the anchor.

tokens.name: cm-r-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the list button.

tokens.name: cm-elev-1
tokens.usage: Rows and small raised parts.

tokens.name: cm-elev-2
tokens.usage: Launcher, preview card, banner.

tokens.name: cm-elev-3
tokens.usage: Thread card, menus, composer, anything being dragged.

tokens.name: cm-elev-edge
tokens.usage: The inner edge of the sidebar.

tokens.name: cm-pin-drop
tokens.usage: Fixed drop shadow under a pin and the launcher. Does not deepen in dark, because the host page did not change.

tokens.name: cm-pin-lift
tokens.usage: Fixed deeper shadow for an on-page part that is hovered, dragged or floating: the launcher, a lifted pin, the toast.

tokens.name: cm-fs-face
tokens.usage: Initials inside a face. Never running text.

tokens.name: cm-fs-meta
tokens.usage: Times, counts, labels.

tokens.name: cm-fs-body
tokens.usage: Everything else.

tokens.name: cm-fs-head
tokens.usage: Card and panel titles: body size, strong weight.

tokens.name: cm-fs-type
tokens.usage: Text typed into a field on a touch device, and only there: below 16px a phone zooms the page when the field is touched.

tokens.name: cm-fw-regular
tokens.usage: Running text.

tokens.name: cm-fw-strong
tokens.usage: Names, titles, button labels.

tokens.name: cm-lh
tokens.usage: Line height everywhere.

tokens.name: cm-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, fades.

tokens.name: cm-medium
tokens.usage: Cards, panel and menus opening.

tokens.name: cm-linger
tokens.usage: Only the warning fading out.

tokens.name: cm-instant
tokens.usage: Reduced motion, and anything that tracks the pointer.

tokens.name: cm-ease
tokens.usage: The one curve for working motion. No spring.

tokens.name: cm-mark-blink
tokens.usage: The mark blinking, once, when the pointer reaches the launcher.

tokens.name: cm-mark-nod
tokens.usage: The mark in the panel bobbing and winking, once.

tokens.name: cm-mark-shut
tokens.usage: The curve an eye closes on: it drops fast.

tokens.name: cm-mark-open
tokens.usage: The curve an eye opens on: hard, then settling.

tokens.name: cm-plant
tokens.usage: A draft pin dropping onto its spot: the one signature.

tokens.name: cm-z-dock
tokens.usage: Launcher.

tokens.name: cm-z-card
tokens.usage: Cards and menus.

tokens.name: cm-z-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar.

tokens.name: cm-z-banner
tokens.usage: Storage warning; above everything.
